description: This file defines the class SugarWidgetSubPanelTopFilterButton, which is a widget class used to generate a filter button for subpanels in the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM interface. It includes a method `display` that renders an HTML button with associated JavaScript for showing a search/filter panel.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopFilterButton
classes.description: A widget class used to render a filter button in subpanels for SuiteCRM/SugarCRM

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates HTML for a filter button, including a script include and a button with an onclick event to show a search panel
